title: Settings
description: The control center for VisaFlow — appearance, data, privacy, and more.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: How VisaFlow looks on this device.
appearance.themeHint: System follows your operating system setting.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the interface. Turkish is the default.
language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Document codes and exported JSON never change with language.

countryPacks.title: Country packs
countryPacks.description: The visa-requirement packs available in VisaFlow.
countryPacks.activeHint: Changing this updates the document checklist for your dossier.
countryPacks.noDossier: Load or start a dossier to choose an active destination.
countryPacks.notEndorsed: These are organizational packs, not an official endorsement. Always verify requirements with current official sources.
countryPacks.empty: No country packs are available yet.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.inMemory: Your dossiers are saved in this browser so they are here when you come back. They are never sent to a server. Clearing your browser data deletes them — export a JSON copy to keep a backup.
privacy.storedBody: Your dossiers are stored in this browser's local database, along with two non-personal interface preferences (theme and language). Local storage is not encryption: anyone who can use this browser profile can open your dossiers. On a shared computer, choose "Session only" when creating a dossier, or delete saved dossiers when you finish.
privacy.noTracking: No accounts, no server, no analytics, no tracking, no third-party requests. Everything runs locally in your browser.

data.title: Local data
data.description: What is currently loaded on this device.

reset.confirmBody: This clears the editor and stops this dossier from reopening automatically. If it is saved on this device it stays saved, and you can open it again from the Dossiers page. Anything not saved on this device will be gone.

importExport.title: Import & export
importExport.description: Move your dossier in and out of VisaFlow as a JSON file.
importExport.exportBody: Download this dossier as a JSON file. That file is your backup — the copy in this browser is not one, because clearing site data removes it.
importExport.nothingToExport: There is nothing to export yet.
importExport.importBody: Load a dossier from a JSON file you exported earlier. It is added as a new dossier — nothing you already have is replaced.
importExport.exampleBody: Load a fictional example dossier to explore VisaFlow. It is added as a new dossier — nothing you already have is replaced.
importExport.importError: Couldn't import that file. Check that it is a VisaFlow JSON export.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.p1: VisaFlow is an organizational tool. It does not provide legal advice, represent any embassy or visa center, or guarantee a visa decision. Always verify requirements using current official sources.
disclaimer.p2: The document checklists and consistency checks are general organizational guidance only. Requirements may vary based on your nationality, the specific embassy processing your application, and current regulations which may change without notice.
disclaimer.p3: Before submitting your visa application, always confirm the requirements with the official embassy, consulate, or authorized visa center.
disclaimer.noPrediction: VisaFlow does not and will not estimate the likelihood of a visa being granted or refused. It measures how complete and internally consistent your dossier is — nothing more.

about.title: About VisaFlow
about.vision: VisaFlow is the open-source, privacy-first application workspace for international visa preparation.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Developer-oriented details. Most people don't need these.
advanced.storageNote: These are the only keys VisaFlow writes to your browser's local storage, and both are non-personal. Dossiers themselves are stored separately in this browser's IndexedDB database.
